Historically recognized as the global benchmark for premium retail equipment and trolley manufacturing, 
Wanzl has successfully evolved into a 
total solutions provider optimizing customer experiences.
 

To support the ambitious course in Belgium and Luxembourg, Wanzl is looking for an entrepreunerial Business Development Manager.  This role is pivotal in driving the new era, turning premium product innovations and digital solutions into sustainable market share.
 

As Business Development Manager, you act as 'co-architect' of the business transformation in BeLux, supporting the General Manager. You combine traditional sales with high-level strategic business development to gain market share with new, digital, and automated solutions. You pioneer new growth areas while further expanding existing strategic partnerships.
 
 

• You further design and implement a sustainable go-to-market strategy to successfully position the renewed Wanzl portfolio in the market. 

• You take responsibility for major, existing key accounts in retail and proactively expand the C-level relationship network within complex Decision Making Units. 

• You actively identify market opportunities for product innovations (such as digital retail and automation solutions) and lead the acquisition process from A to Z, including complex price negotiations. 

• You implement structured and data-driven sales management (CRM, forecasting, and account planning) to achieve commercial performance and strict P&L and margin targets. 

• You work closely with the local sales and operational teams and the international headquarters to guarantee an optimal customer journey and efficient collaboration. 
 

• You hold a university degree and have 10 to 15 years of proven successful B2B sales and business development experience, preferably in retail or other relevant sector. 

• You are accustomed to operating in highly competitive markets and have experience managing complex key accounts. 

• You combine a strong commercial and entrepreneurial mindset with analytical skills and a P&L and margin focus, capable of translating data into concrete actions. 

• You have a proactive hands-on mentality and enjoy taking independent initiative to drive the business forward. 

• You communicate convincingly at various levels and are fluent in Dutch and French (required for the local market), as well as English (communications with HQ and other affiliates). Knowledge of German is a nice plus.

jobs.occupation: Customer Experience Specialist France - Region Kontich
jobs.description:
Our client is looking for a Customer Experience Specialist to support and further develop their French-speaking customer base. In this role, you will ensure an outstanding customer journey from order placement to delivery and after-sales support while building long-term customer relationships.

 

Client Details

Our client is an internationally recognised company, operating within the lifestyle industry. 
With a strong focus on innovation and customer satisfaction, our client has built an excellent reputation in both B2B and B2C markets. To strengthen their customer experience team, they are currently looking for a service-driven professional with a strong affinity for the French market.
 
Company is located in the region of Kontich/Edegem. Easy connection with car & public transport.

 

Description

• Act as the primary point of contact for customers in the French market (B2B).
• Advise customers on products, collections, and available solutions.
• Handle customer enquiries via phone and email in a professional and solution-oriented manner.
• Process, manage, and follow up on orders within the ERP system.
• Coordinate the order flow and ensure timely delivery to customers.
• Work closely with the sales, logistics, and planning teams to guarantee a seamless customer experience.
• Manage customer complaints and provide effective and customer-focused solutions.
• Support commercial initiatives, quotations, and after-sales activities.
• Identify opportunities to improve processes, communication, and customer service.
• Contribute actively to customer loyalty and long-term customer relationships.
 

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in customer service, internal sales or customer support.
• Native-level French proficiency.
• Good command of English.
• Strong affinity with French culture and the French market.
• Experience within lifestyle or premium consumer goods sector is considered a strong asset.
• Commercial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for additional sales.
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
• Solution-oriented and able to perform effectively under pressure.
• Excellent communication skills and customer-centric attitude.
• Team player with a proactive mindset.
• Passion for premium-quality products.

As a Project Manager you are in charge of the organisation, coordination of assessments for members of the association in many different countries in Europe. 

Client Details

European association located in Brussels

Description

• You coordinate and ensure the smooth delivery of the assessments, online or face-to-face 
• You liaise with candidates, suppliers, volunteers, committee members, speakers, examiners and hosts
• You work closely with the subcommittee, attending their meetings, taking minutes and ensuring the implementation of their decisions and policies.
• You work closely with the Registration, IT, Finance, Education and Communication departments.
• You carry out various organisational and administrative tasks such as maintaining examination data, drafting reports, updating procedures and policies, and promoting courses and examinations.

• You hold a bachelor's degree or higher qualification and have at least three years' relevant experience in project, administration, event, examination or programme coordination
• English excellent level
• You have a special interest in education and training.
• You are a methodical and meticulous organiser who maintains high standards and pays close attention to detail.
• You show a diplomatic attitude, making it easy for you to interact and communicate in a mature and professional manner within and outside the organisation.
• You are willing to travel by plane (7-8 times a year).
• You are willing to deliver activities scheduled on weekends (9-10 weekends a year).

As a Process Assistant (PA) in the SEM Operations team, you will work hands-on with state-of-the-art inline SEM and XSEM tools to support high-quality wafer inspection, process monitoring, and operational excellence across the imec Fab.
 

What you will do 
 

Operational Excellence 
 
 

• Contribute to day-to-day operational readiness of SEM tools within a 24/7 production environment  

• Collaborate with First Line Support (FLS), Equipment, and Process Engineers to ensure tool availability, stability, and performance  

• Act as a technical bridge between Operations and Engineering to enable smooth coordination and handovers  

• Support cross-functional initiatives aimed at reducing cycle time and improving tool efficiency  

• Escalate tool or process issues and follow up on non-conformities related to tool behaviour, inspection quality, or data integrity   

Inspection & Process Support 
 
 

• Manage incoming SEM metrology requests and verify their alignment with tool capabilities and process specifications  

• Advise requesters on optimal inspection strategies, including recommending more suitable metrology techniques when appropriate  

• Review and interpret inline SEM/XSEM output, as well as macro- and microscopic wafer inspections; share findings with process engineers and other stakeholders  

• Support timely wafer movement by proactively screening flows and reports (e.g., hold queues, tool down/forecast reports), and contribute to reducing hold times  

• Coordinate inspection reservations and align with stakeholders to minimize cycle time impact, supporting the fab’s overall KPI targets  

• Review and append SEM and FIB signature/authorization requests  

• Share Best Known Methods (BKMs) and documentation templates to support consistent and high-quality inspection output across the team   

Team & Knowledge Sharing 
 
 

• Collaborate with operators, FLS, and engineers to execute daily priorities efficiently and accurately  

• Support training, onboarding, and continuous learning within the team  

• Contribute to knowledge transfer by sharing insights on inspection data interpretation, inspection techniques, and tool behaviour  

Who you are 
 
 

• A bachelor's in chemistry, Physics, Electronics, Electromechanics, or similar industrial experience  

• Eager to learn and self-organized  

• Good sense of urgency and the flexibility to take on tasks in function of project needs  

• Accurate and organized  

• Dedicated to a high standard of quality and work  

• Resilient and problem-solving  

• Independent and proactive  

• Decisive and assertive  

• Good social- and communication skills  

• Proficient English   

We seek a candidate who thrives in a dynamic work environment, showcasing an adaptability to diverse projects or research topics. You’ll be a key team player, ready to support colleagues and tackle impactful projects within the timelines of our trusted global partners. 
 

 
 

IMEC and its affiliates will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. IMEC will consider unsolicited referrals and/or resumes submitted by vendors such as search firms, staffing agencies, professional recruiters, fee-based referral services and recruiting agencies (hereafter “Agency”) to have been referred by the Agency free of charge. IMEC will not pay a fee to any Agency that does not have a prior written agreement with IMEC, validated by its HR department, in place regarding a specific job opening and allowing to submit resumes.
